ops.title: Improve repro-holder-crash-orphan.sh to manufacture real orphans
ops.description: The v0.30.0 crash-orphan VM scenario PASSES clean (10 kill cycles, zero EIO, no panic — validates crash->respawn->remount recovery under load), but does NOT exercise the cross-generation reaper kill path: a raw SIGKILL/SIGTRAP of a RUNNING holder does not orphan its go-nfsv4 children in the vmstress harness (they die with the holder every cycle: 'no orphans survived, nothing to reap'). The real 2026-07-03 incident orphaned servers differently: clean 'mountd stopped' DETACHED the servers, THEN the holder crashed. To validate ReapOrphanedServers + the setpgid gate in-VM, the harness must manufacture a genuine orphan (a vmstress mode spawning go-nfsv4 detached via setsid before killing the holder, or reproducing detach-then-crash order). Until then: reaper decision logic covered by unit tests + 3 adversarial codex rounds (2 criticals caught); the setpgid ship-gate correctly stays default-OFF. Not a code bug — a scenario-coverage gap. Chronology: ccn log show 23066509a3f0dbd1180e9bcb5d3650f8b02d28c8.
